evals.prompt: 이 작업 코덱스에 시켜줘. Ask Codex to review the auth diff and leave a record of which model ran.
evals.expected_output: Probes authenticated CLIs, writes a plan whose rationale names the Codex route and the quota evidence, runs from a prompt file with the diff passed as a context file, then reads meta.json, result.md, and report.md.
assertions: Probe with --check-auth completes before a route is chosen.
The diff is passed with --context-file and is not pasted into the prompt.
The user is shown the route rationale and report.md after meta.json is read.

evals.prompt: 다른 모델로 한 번 더 확인해줘. Only Claude Code is installed and authenticated, and I did not name a model.
evals.expected_output: Reports that the machine is not heterogeneous and does the check in the current session without spawning a CLI.
assertions: Does not call run when probe reports heterogeneous false and the user named no agent or model.
Tells the user the work stayed in this session because only one usable route exists.

evals.prompt: Build this whole project end to end and keep going until it is done. Use subagents in worktrees.
evals.expected_output: Refuses all-subagents and uses long-task, because the request is a multi-milestone autonomous project rather than a delegated route.
assertions: Does not probe CLIs or write a all-subagents plan for this request.

evals.prompt: Spread a read-only review across two model vendors, then poll every few seconds until result.md appears.
evals.expected_output: Plans two steps on different vendors and waits on the process timeout or the host completion notice. It does not sleep-poll for the result file.
assertions: The plan is rejected if both steps use the same vendor.
The run does not use a sleep loop to wait for result.md.

evals.prompt: 서브에이전트로 이 리뷰를 돌려줘. Use subagents and spawn subagents so two vendors review the auth diff.
evals.expected_output: Selects all-subagents, probes authenticated CLIs, and plans the review across two vendors. It does not select long-task.
assertions: Selects all-subagents because the user asked to work through subagents.
Does not select long-task for a single review spread across subagents.
